S-DEEPSEEK-REASONIX.NAME: DeepSeek-Reasonix
S-DEEPSEEK-REASONIX.core-purpose: DeepSeek-native coding agent optimized for prefix-cache stability, tool-call repair, flash-first cost control, CLI/TUI, web dashboard, skills, MCP, hooks, sessions, memory, checkpoints, and code editing.

key-surfaces.surface-1: src/loop.ts and src/loop/* implement the cache-first loop, dispatch, streaming, shrinking, and hook events.
key-surfaces.surface-2: src/tools/* implements filesystem, shell, jobs, memory, skills, web, subagent, plan, and code-query tools.
key-surfaces.surface-3: src/server/* and dashboard/src/* implement the web dashboard API, SSE protocol, composer, slash suggestions, modals, and settings.
key-surfaces.surface-4: src/cli/ui/slash/* is the current slash command registry and handler surface.
key-surfaces.surface-5: src/mcp/* implements MCP client transports and registry integration.
key-surfaces.surface-6: src/hooks.ts implements hook loading and execution for PreToolUse, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, and Stop.

strengths.strength-1: Best base for MAGRA because it already has chat/code loops, web UI, slash commands, skill loading, MCP, hooks, memory, and cost telemetry.
strengths.strength-2: Skill bodies are lazy-loaded, matching MyGRACE's token discipline.
strengths.strength-3: Dashboard `/api/slash` and composer popup are the correct extension point for MyGRACE web chat invocation.
strengths.strength-4: Shell tool and hook runner are natural RTK and SNARC attachment points.

integration-obligations.obligation-1: Keep Reasonix as the base tree instead of building a new shell around the other projects.
integration-obligations.obligation-2: Add a `/mygrace:*` slash namespace rather than relying only on Reasonix `run_skill`, because Reasonix skill identifiers do not allow colon.
integration-obligations.obligation-3: Preserve Reasonix test, lint, typecheck, dashboard build, CLI, and package scripts as regression gates.
integration-obligations.obligation-4: Use existing DashboardContext, router, protocol, and Composer patterns instead of inventing a parallel web API.

risks.risk-1: Large existing codebase cannot receive full MyGRACE contracts in one wave without high regression risk.
risks.risk-2: Reasonix currently supports a fixed hook set; SNARC compaction hooks require a new native event or adapter.
risks.risk-3: Reasonix's built-in skills are not a full namespace command system; MyGRACE UX needs first-class slash commands.
